Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V3-D-ortugg-2022-12-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V3-D-ortugg-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V3-D-ortugg-2022-12-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V3-D-ortugg-2022-12-01.png]], 1 December 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
